      - term: United Kingdom

        - text: "UK status (MHRA products database, 25 September 2026): no UK product information. A search for tesamorelin returned no summary of product characteristics, patient leaflet or assessment report."

      - term: European Union
      - definition:
        - text: "In the EU, tesamorelin has no marketing authorisation: the application for Egrifta (excess abdominal fat in HIV lipodystrophy) was withdrawn on 21 June 2012, when the provisional view of EMA's human-medicines committee (CHMP) was that it could not be approved, partly because raised IGF-1 was a major safety concern."
        - generic: "Source: Egrifta (tesamorelin) — withdrawal of the marketing authorisation application · Union Register of medicinal products for human use (authorised, not active and refused lists)"
      - term: Brazil
      - definition:
        - text: In Brazil, no registered medicine containing tesamorelin, including Egrifta, was found in ANVISA's register or online search (25 September 2026).
        - generic: "Source: Dados abertos de medicamentos registrados (DADOS_ABERTOS_MEDICAMENTOS.csv) · Documentação e Dicionário de Dados – Registros Válidos Medicamento V1 · Consultas – Medicamentos (product and substance search)"
      - term: United Arab Emirates
      - definition:
        - text: In the UAE, the Emirates Drug Establishment (EDE) has held medicines registration since Federal Decree-Law 28/2023; the medicines law is Federal Decree-Law 38 of 2024. No registered product containing tesamorelin, and none named Egrifta, was found in the EDE register (25 September 2026). In Dubai, the DHA prohibits prescribing, dispensing or using any peptide product that is not registered or licensed with the EDE (29 July 2026); in Abu Dhabi, physicians may prescribe peptide therapies only for clinical indications supported by available scientific evidence, after a documented eligibility assessment and with informed consent that covers the product's regulatory approval status (DoH, 31 July 2026).
        - generic: "Source: Federal Decree-Law No. (28) of 2023 On the Establishment of the UAE Drug Corporation (official English translation) · Federal Decree-Law No. (38) of 2024 Governing Medical Products, Pharmacists and Pharmaceutical Establishments (official English translation) · Registered medical product directory (Drug Directory) · DHA External Circular DHA/OUT/2026/0000867: Regulations for Handling Peptide Products in Healthcare Facilities (technical annex) · DoH Circular No. (148)/2026: Mandatory Requirements for Peptide Products"
      - term: Saudi Arabia
      - definition: "Saudi context: assess exact products, indications and routes separately for tesamorelin, sermorelin, ipamorelin, CJC-1295 and ibutamoren. This review has not established Saudi registration for exact products; US compounding lists or overseas use do not establish permission."
    - paragraph: Tesamorelin is the instructive exception on this axis. Both Hormonaly guides grade it A, for one indication. Read the record in order.
    - strong: Trials
    - generic: Two phase 3 RCTs, 806 patients
    - generic: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled and run by the developer, in adults with HIV and excess abdominal fat
    - strong: Result
    - generic: About 15% less visceral fat than placebo at 26 weeks
    - generic: Subcutaneous fat unchanged; the reduction held to 52 weeks on continued treatment
    - strong: US status (label, August 2026)
    - generic: FDA-approved since 2010, for one use
    - generic: Reduction of excess abdominal fat in adults with HIV-associated lipodystrophy. The label says it is not for weight loss and that long-term cardiovascular safety has not been established.
    - strong: Safety, in its own label
    - generic: IGF-1 above +2 SD in 47% at 26 weeks
    - generic: Diabetes-range HbA1c in 5% against 1% on placebo; fluid retention; contraindicated in active malignancy
    - strong: Grade
    - generic: A, for HIV-associated abdominal fat only
    - generic: No trial has tested skin, anti-ageing or general body shaping
    - paragraph: A GRADE A travels with its indication. The molecule does not carry it anywhere else.
